name: URinth Boost
description: Frame rate help for crowds. Only while your frame rate is low, it stops drawing the things that cost the most and are missed the least: extra particles, far dropped items, far armor stands and small mobs, far name tags, and the armor of far players. Nothing about the game, the server or your settings changes. /uboost shows what it is doing and /uboost bench measures what it gains on your phone.
